# Smartcale Companion Application

> Smart kitchen scale companion app for real-time weighing, calorie & macro tracking, interactive recipes, and Bluetooth LE hardware integration.

The Smartcale Companion App connects to the Smartcale ESP32 hardware scale via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE GATT). It provides live weight telemetry, remote Tare, interactive recipe mixing with auto-tare steps, Open Food Facts barcode scanning, and daily nutrition logging.

## Core Capabilities

- **Real-Time Bluetooth LE Telemetry:** Connects to `SmartKitchenScale` GATT service (`4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b`) and receives live weight notifications (characteristic `beb5483e-36e1-4688-b7f5-ea07361b26a8`).
- **Remote Tare & Calibration:** Transmits tare commands (`'T'`) and calibration factor adjustments to command characteristic `1c95d5e3-d8f7-413a-bf3d-7a2e5d7be87e`.
- **Interactive Recipe Mode:** Multi-ingredient mixing workflow with automatic tare between steps, proportional nutritional breakdowns, and AI prompt exports.
- **Nutritional Database & Barcode Scanning:** Integrated with Open Food Facts and camera barcode scanning via `@zxing/library`.
- **Cross-Platform Delivery:** Runs natively on Android (Capacitor), iOS, and desktop browsers supporting Web Bluetooth.

## Application Architecture

- **UI Framework:** React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling:** CSS variables, responsive mobile-first layout, dark/light theme toggle
- **Internationalization:** English (`en`) and Turkish (`tr`)
- **Native Bridge:** Capacitor 8 with `@capacitor-community/bluetooth-le`
